patch_description: Crossover of the incremental area-update local search (best performer, combined 0.76) with the current program's softmax/barycentric smooth optimization and deterministic seeds, plus the perpendicular-direction guided moves and merge/crossover phase from the inspiration scripts. The core is the fast incremental best-of-K point-move engine (only recomputing areas of triples containing the moved point), augmented with guided perpendicular moves on the worst triplet, boundary-heavy warm starts (vertices + lattices + edge points), and a phase-2 merge polish over the top-3 configurations. This is far faster than full-batch evaluation and Powell optimization, allowing many more restarts within a 9-second budget.
